Phase 1 COMPLETE. Classified all 97 R2-hosted deps (400.8 GB) by matching our recorded sha256 against HF LFS oids (HF tree API exposes lfs.oid, which IS the sha256, so matching is by HASH not by path). Result: 56 deps / 276.5 GB already hosted byte-identical by third parties, 9 deps / 86.4 GB already on our own HF repo, 32 deps / 37.8 GB must be uploaded.

Phase 1.5 COMPLETE. key_decisions: ORIGIN = Hugging Face, NOT a second Cloudflare hostname. A second cubric.studio subdomain only dodges an FQDN-keyed filter, and MPI-427 names the likely trigger as cubric.studio being a young uncategorised domain - category filters block the REGISTRABLE DOMAIN. madponyinteractive.com fails the same test (also young). HF beats FQDN, domain and provider keying.

R2 STAYS PRIMARY on both engines. The HF/Xet throttling that the R2 migration (MPI-129/140) fixed is MULTI-CONNECTION: aria2c lives only in the Pod wrapper, and the local path uses single-stream DownloaderHelper. So HF is fine for local. _mirrorUrlsFor lives in the downloadManager.js FileDownloader and the Pod never consults it - the mirror is LOCAL-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION and cannot regress Pod speed. No engine-split sweep needed.

STAY ON THE FREE HF TIER. An earlier pass in this session said PRO off a 228.7 GB estimate and was WRONG. The billing page shows free already carries a real 8.7 TB public quota (0.09 TB used), not the vague best-effort the docs imply. 37.8 GB is noise. Do not buy PRO.

Custom nodes and the engine archive need NO mirror. All 14 nodesDeps entries resolve to github.com, and the engine archive comes from github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/releases/download (routes/platformEngine.js:20). MPI-427 log: github 45/45 succeeded, models.cubric.studio 0/44. Only model weights are affected.

DEPS NOW NEED A SECOND URL. The MPI-427 brief said explicitly NOT to add a per-dep url field, but that held only while a mirror mirrored OUR layout. 56 deps live at third-party repos with different paths AND filenames, so an origin swap cannot reach them. Generate a per-dep mirrorUrl from the sweep data - do not hand-write it.

coyotte / LUSTIFY acquisition is SETTLED, do not re-open. The dep landed 2026-07-16 inside the paid early-access window (released 2026-07-10, open date 2026-08-10), which LOOKS like giving away a paid release. It was acquired legitimately: Fabio subscribed to the creator paid channel and deliberately bought THREE months rather than one to over-remunerate him, and they have discussed it directly. Decision: ship as-is, credit on the About page, no outreach. Recorded in docs/models/krea2/licences.md.
constraints: THE SHA256 GATE: every dep is sha256-verified after download. A mirror serving different bytes fails the verify and the file is DELETED. So an upstream copy qualifies only if byte-identical. This is why the classification matched by hash.

_isSameObjectUrl compares PATHNAMES to decide partial-resume. HF paths will not match R2 paths, so as written it would scrap the partial - the exact MPI-317 data loss it was added to prevent. It must key on dep id or sha256 before phase 3 ships.

DO NOT RELOCATE the 9 v1.0.1 files at the root of Mad-Pony-Interactive/cubric-studio. Shipped v1.0.1 hardcodes those flat HF resolve URLs in its bundled dependencies.js, so MOVING them breaks it in the wild exactly as deleting would. ADD the new layout alongside. Source: MadPony-Identity/capabilities/huggingface/README.md.

HF Hub API rate limit is 1k requests per 5-minute interval. An unauthenticated wide sweep over ~3700 repos blew through it and made every call 429 for a while. Use the token at C:/Users/Fabio/.secrets/hf.txt and keep concurrency modest.

HF token type matters: use a plain Write token, not fine-grained. See the capability README - a fine-grained token created before a repo existed has no write to it and fails with 403 pass create_pr=1.
CivitAI region-blocks the UK and agent WebFetch can NEVER reach it. The licence sweep needed the Fabio VPN, which was on for it and can be off now. CivitAI key is at .secrets/civit.txt.
The CivitAI v1 API is BLIND to the licence badge. Flags alone are not the method - grep choosealicense/licenses/blob/main/markdown/ from the page with -L and a browser UA.
CivArchive ids in the origin field are NOT CivitAI model ids - a lookup by that number 404s. Resolve by SHA256.
